8 22 58] Mahābhārata [Karnavadha Parvan
<sig>C 8 1318 B 8 31 68 K 8 22 72</sig>

In every way, I shall conquer all the Pāṇḍavas who have gathered today. 58

Duryodhana said:
I will do all this as you think best, O Karṇa. Chariots complete with quivers shall surely follow you, O son of a charioteer. 59
Let them also carry arrows with straight feathers and supply carts.

<column-break/>

We, along with all the kings, shall follow you, O Karṇa. 60

Sañjaya said:
Having spoken thus, O great king, your valorous son, the king, approached the King of the Madras <note>referring to Śalya</note> and spoke these words. 61

->Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the Karṇa Parvan of the glorious Mahābhārata. 22<-

---

## 23

Sañjaya said:
Your son, O great king, approached the King of the Madras with humility and spoke these words out of affection. 1
O truthful one, O highly fortunate one, O you who increase the sorrow of your enemies,
